actionResultText:
Here's your **Projectile Motion Explorer**! 🚀

### How to use it:

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Launch Angle** slider | Adjusts θ from 0° → 90°; trajectory updates instantly |
| **Launch Speed** slider | Sets $v_0$ from 10 → 100 m/s |
| **Gravity** slider | Changes $g$ from 1 → 20 m/s² (try Moon gravity at ~1.6!) |
| **Launch button** | Animates the projectile dot flying along the path |

### Key physics at a glance:

$$x(t) = v_0 \cos\theta \cdot t$$
$$y(t) = v_0 \sin\theta \cdot t - \tfrac{1}{2}g t^2$$

- **Max Range** is achieved at **θ = 45°** (try it!)
- **Time of flight:** $T = \dfrac{2 v_0 \sin\theta}{g}$
- **Max height:** $H = \dfrac{(v_0 \sin\theta)^2}{2g}$

> 💡 **Try this:** Set gravity to 1.6 m/s² (Moon) vs. 9.8 m/s² (Earth) at the same angle and speed — notice how far the projectile travels on the Moon!
